orientationControl.notes: Fresh exact Q2006129 way 116944490 independently confirms the individual 330 m/74-level China World Tower A rectangular footprint, unchanged from the cached 58.465 by 52.803 m ring within 0.002 m rounding. Retain anchor [116.45236545,39.91097545] and heading -1.568897708342: native +X north bearing 359.89 degrees, -Z east bearing 89.89 degrees for the hotel, and +Z west bearing 269.89 degrees for offices. SOM explicitly documents office entrance west and hotel entrance east, supplying the signed cardinal control that the rectangle alone lacks. Primary architect whole/base/fin/canopy photographs and facade-consultant pages 10/11 were actually inspected. Authored body half dimensions 28.65/25.8 m sit about 0.6 m inside the exact mapped rectangle; chamfers/recesses simplify its ring and projecting diamond fins/canopies intentionally extend beyond it. Entrance sides are documented but centered offsets, vestibule positions, widths and canopy extents are illustrative photo reconstructions, not surveyed. Separate ballroom/retail annexes, mall, road skywalk, fountains, Tower B and actual terrain/plaza grade remain outside this individual tower. Flat geographic capture certifies relative footprint and facing only.
